title: Italian Galette with Roasted Potatoes
description: A delicious Italian-inspired dish featuring a crispy galette crust topped with roasted potatoes and a hint of Russian flair.
instructions: Toss sliced potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast potatoes in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Roll out the galette sheet to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the galette to a baking sheet or pizza stone.
Spread the roasted potatoes evenly over the galette, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil over the potatoes.
Sprinkle minced garlic over the potatoes.
Bake the galette in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
